formula: lambda = c / f; propagation_length = lambda * velocity_factor

velocity_factor.meaning: User-supplied propagation velocity ratio relative to c. A value of 1 represents free space.

assumptions: The calculation is an ideal electromagnetic wavelength/electrical-length calculation.
Quarter-wave and half-wave outputs are not guaranteed physical resonant antenna cut lengths.
Real antennas, feed lines, insulation, geometry, surroundings and end effects can change physical dimensions.
